title: Little Snitch Rule Group (.lsrules)
description: Schema for Little Snitch 6 .lsrules rule-group files. These files are imported or subscribed to via the GUI or apply_lsrules_file_to_live_model; they are NOT the same format as the export-model JSON.

name.description: Display name of the rule group as it appears in the Little Snitch UI.

description.description: Optional human-readable description shown in the rule group details pane.

rules.description: Individual connection rules in this group.

denied-remote-domains.description: Compact domain blocklist. All connections to these domains are denied for any process.

denied-remote-hosts.description: Compact hostname blocklist. All connections to these hostnames are denied for any process.

denied-remote-addresses.description: Compact IP/CIDR blocklist. All connections to these addresses are denied for any process.

denied-remote-notes.description: Annotation for the denied-remote-* lists; shown in the UI alongside the deny entries.

rule.description: A single Little Snitch connection rule.

action.description: What to do when the rule matches: allow, deny, or prompt the user.

process.description: Absolute path to the process binary, or the special value "any" to match all processes. Mutually exclusive with requiresTrustedSignatureForAnyProcess.

requiresTrustedSignatureForAnyProcess.description: When true, matches any process that carries a valid Apple code signature. Used for system-level rules. Mutually exclusive with "process".

remote.description: Special named remote endpoint. Mutually exclusive with remote-domains, remote-hosts, and remote-addresses.

remote-domains.description: Domain or list of domains to match. A single domain may be given as a string; multiple domains as an array.

remote-hosts.description: Hostname or list of hostnames to match.

remote-addresses.description: IP address, CIDR range, or list thereof to match.

direction.description: Connection direction to match. Defaults to "outgoing" when absent.

priority.description: Rule priority. High-priority rules are evaluated before regular ones. Defaults to "regular" when absent.

ports.description: Port or port range to match: a single port ("443"), a comma-separated list ("80,443"), or a range ("8080-8090").

protocol.description: Transport protocol to match. Defaults to "any" when absent.

via.description: Absolute path of the parent process that must be present for the rule to match (e.g. a launcher or shell).

disabled.description: When true the rule is stored but not evaluated. Useful for temporarily suppressing a rule.

notes.description: Free-text annotation visible in the Little Snitch UI.
